custom_preconds:
Staging org with the QuickBooks org feature flag ON (so the check WOULD fire for a permitted role).
Custom role: Settings > Parts ON (to reach Parts > Categories) + Settings > Integrations OFF.
Role provisioned via API with a confirmed user.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as the role and open Parts > Categories.
Wait for the page to settle after mount.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The 'Checking QuickBooks connection...' row does not appear.

custom_steps_separated.content: Observe notifications during and after mount.
custom_steps_separated.expected: No 'An error occurred while checking QuickBooks connection.' error toast is shown.

title: QuickBooks connection check suppressed for roles without settingsIntegrations
